subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Should the iOS chat owner require the reporter's screenshots and an exact current-main event/history replay before authorizing a reconciliation change?
rationale: Adjacent guards already exist, and source inspection cannot safely distinguish an already-covered released race from a remaining stable-identity, ordering, or tool-projection defect.

options.title: Require exact replay first
options.body: Collect the offered artifacts and encode the reported concurrent history completions in the shared chat-view-model harness before choosing a code change.

options.title: Proceed from source hypothesis
options.body: Sponsor a focused reconciliation patch now, accepting a higher risk of duplicating existing guards or fixing the wrong projection layer.

options.title: Close after device verification
options.body: Close only if an owner reproduces the same sequence on current main and confirms the transcript remains ordered and deduplicated.

recommendation.title: Require exact replay first
recommendation.body: Collect the offered artifacts and encode the reported concurrent history completions in the shared chat-view-model harness before choosing a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work and issue routing most directly connect this person to the shared iOS reconciliation path.
